inference_rule: physical 10 m prior + per-pixel residual from native 10 m features and prior, scored by the shared exact nested 10x10 pooling at 100 m
primary_metric: masked MAE @ 100 m (cell-weighted over valid cells)
prior_rule: native 100 m Landsat LST mean-pooled 10x10 to 1000 m over native-valid cells, block-expanded to the 10 m grid on the global canonical lattice, then the exact nested 10x10 pool back to 100 m (= the 1000 m block mean)
secondary_metric: SSIM @ 100 m, 7x7 uniform window, fully-valid windows only, logged only (never a selection gate)
target_rule: Landsat_100m - prior_100m (K): one row per eligible 100 m cell, target and prior on the native 100 m cell grid

train_pool.rule: Algorithm R over the index-ordered train-cell stream, seeded; at most max_cells rows, one row per distinct (scene_id, year, global_row, global_col)
train_pool.weighting: one row per distinct (scene_id, year, global_row, global_col); a cell repeated by an overlapping window is skipped, not upweighted
